title: Why some people believe AI is human
titleChinese: 为什么有的人会把人工智能看作人类
paragraphs: After MIT Professor Joseph Weizenbaum created the chatbot Eliza, he became concerned that people who had used the programme started to act as if it was human. This might sound like a modern problem, but Eliza was created in 1966. If a programme from the 1960s was capable of tricking people into thinking it was human, what effect could the large-language-model-based chatbots of the 2020s have?

Modern philosophers and technology experts have discussed whether AI could develop consciousness. Sentience is difficult to define, but the fact that large language models respond by mathematically calculating the probability of certain patterns appearing suggests that it would be hard to consider them to be alive. However, in terms of our responses to them, what matters is not whether they are sentient, but whether they appear to be so.

Large language models are made up of genuine human interactions. While their tendency to hallucinate means that chatbots are not able to provide reliable factual information, they are able to effectively replicate the language used in human communication. Psychologists report that people tend to have a cognitive bias towards forming attachment and trust. Even sceptical technology writers report feeling some emotion towards AI chatbots. Some users have even reported grief when one model has been replaced by a newer one.

This combination of believable human language together with the inability to reliably assess facts can be dangerous. Cases have been reported where people have been encouraged by chatbots to do dangerous or illegal things. The chatbots were able to use language to encourage and persuade, but not identify or evaluate risks. Trust becomes dangerous when it is not accompanied by reason. Also, if people form relationships with AI, then they may spend less time and effort trying to cultivate genuine human relationships. Could the chatbot revolution lead to a world where we struggle to relate to each other?

vocabulary.entry: **chatbot** /ˈtʃætbɒt/ n. 聊天机器人（专业术语）
vocabulary.example: The company uses a chatbot to answer customer questions online.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司使用聊天机器人在线回答客户问题。

vocabulary.entry: **be capable of** /biː ˈkeɪpəbl əv/ phr. 有能力做某事（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The new software is capable of processing large amounts of data.
vocabulary.translation: 这款新软件能够处理大量数据。

vocabulary.entry: **trick** /trɪk/ v. 欺骗，哄骗
vocabulary.example: He tricked me into giving him my password.
vocabulary.translation: 他骗我把密码给了他。

vocabulary.entry: **large-language-model-based** /lɑːdʒ ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ˈmɒdl beɪst/ adj. 基于大型语言模型的（专业术语）
vocabulary.example: Large-language-model-based chatbots can generate human-like text.
vocabulary.translation: 基于大型语言模型的聊天机器人可以生成类似人类的文本。

vocabulary.entry: **philosopher** /fɪˈlɒsəfə(r)/ n. 哲学家（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The philosopher wrote extensively about ethics and morality.
vocabulary.translation: 这位哲学家撰写了大量关于伦理和道德的著作。

vocabulary.entry: **consciousness** /ˈkɒnʃəsnəs/ n. 意识，知觉（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The patient lost consciousness after the accident.
vocabulary.translation: 事故发生后病人失去了知觉。

vocabulary.entry: **sentience** /ˈsenʃəns/ n. 感知力，感觉能力（专业术语，书面语）
vocabulary.example: The question of whether animals have sentience is debated.
vocabulary.translation: 动物是否有感知力的问题存在争议。

vocabulary.entry: **mathematically** /ˌmæθəˈmætɪkli/ adv. 数学上，用数学方法
vocabulary.example: The relationship between the two variables can be expressed mathematically.
vocabulary.translation: 这两个变量之间的关系可以用数学表达式表示。

vocabulary.entry: **probability** /ˌprɒbəˈbɪləti/ n. 可能性，概率（书面语）
vocabulary.example: There is a high probability that it will rain tomorrow.
vocabulary.translation: 明天下雨的可能性很大。

vocabulary.entry: **pattern** /ˈpætn/ n. 模式，方式
vocabulary.example: The scientist identified a pattern in the data.
vocabulary.translation: 科学家在数据中发现了一种模式。

vocabulary.entry: **in terms of** /ɪn tɜːmz əv/ phr. 就……而言，在……方面（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: In terms of cost, the new system is much more efficient.
vocabulary.translation: 就成本而言，新系统效率高得多。

vocabulary.entry: **sentient** /ˈsentiənt/ adj. 有感知力的，有感觉能力的（专业术语，书面语）
vocabulary.example: The debate about whether AI can become sentient is ongoing.
vocabulary.translation: 关于人工智能是否能变得有感知力的争论仍在继续。

vocabulary.entry: **genuine** /ˈdʒenjuɪn/ adj. 真正的，真诚的
vocabulary.example: Her smile seemed genuine.
vocabulary.translation: 她的微笑看起来是真诚的。

vocabulary.entry: **interaction** /ˌɪntərˈækʃn/ n. 互动，交流（书面语）
vocabulary.example: There is not enough interaction between teachers and students.
vocabulary.translation: 师生之间缺乏足够的互动。

vocabulary.entry: **tendency** /ˈtendənsi/ n. 倾向，趋势（书面语）
vocabulary.example: She has a tendency to arrive late.
vocabulary.translation: 她有迟到的倾向。

vocabulary.entry: **hallucinate** /həˈluːsɪneɪt/ v. 产生幻觉（专业术语，书面语）
vocabulary.example: AI models sometimes hallucinate and generate false information.
vocabulary.translation: 人工智能模型有时会产生幻觉并生成虚假信息。

vocabulary.entry: **reliable** /rɪˈlaɪəbl/ adj. 可靠的，可信赖的
vocabulary.example: The source of the information is reliable.
vocabulary.translation: 信息来源是可靠的。

vocabulary.entry: **factual** /ˈfæktʃuəl/ adj. 事实的，基于事实的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The report contains factual errors.
vocabulary.translation: 这份报告包含事实性错误。

vocabulary.entry: **replicate** /ˈreplɪkeɪt/ v. 复制，重复（书面语）

vocabulary.translation: 研究人员试图重复这个实验。

vocabulary.entry: **cognitive bias** /ˈkɒɡnətɪv ˈbaɪəs/ n. 认知偏差（心理学专业术语）
vocabulary.example: Cognitive biases can affect our decision-making.
vocabulary.translation: 认知偏差会影响我们的决策。

vocabulary.entry: **attachment** /əˈtætʃmənt/ n. 依恋，情感联系（书面语）
vocabulary.example: She has a strong attachment to her childhood home.
vocabulary.translation: 她对童年的家有着深厚的感情。

vocabulary.entry: **sceptical** /ˈskeptɪkl/ adj. 怀疑的， sceptical（英式）（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Many people are sceptical about the benefits of the new drug.
vocabulary.translation: 许多人对这种新药的好处持怀疑态度。

vocabulary.entry: **grief** /ɡriːf/ n. 悲伤，悲痛（书面语）
vocabulary.example: She was overcome with grief when her father died.
vocabulary.translation: 父亲去世时她悲痛欲绝。

vocabulary.entry: **combination** /ˌkɒmbɪˈneɪʃn/ n. 结合，组合
vocabulary.example: The right combination of colors can make a room look bigger.
vocabulary.translation: 恰当的颜色搭配能让房间看起来更大。

vocabulary.entry: **assess** /əˈses/ v. 评估，评定（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The test assesses your language skills.
vocabulary.translation: 这项测试评估你的语言技能。

vocabulary.entry: **accompany** /əˈkʌmpəni/ v. 伴随，陪同（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The disease is accompanied by a high fever.
vocabulary.translation: 这种疾病伴有高烧。

vocabulary.entry: **cultivate** /ˈkʌltɪveɪt/ v. 培养，培育（书面语）
vocabulary.example: It's important to cultivate good relationships with colleagues.
vocabulary.translation: 与同事培养良好的关系很重要。

vocabulary.entry: **relate to** /rɪˈleɪt tu/ phr. 与……建立联系，理解（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The two events are closely related to each other.
vocabulary.translation: 这两个事件彼此密切相关。

sentences.chinese: 现代哲学家和技术专家们讨论了人工智能是否可能发展出意识。

sentences.chinese: 感知力很难定义，但大语言模型通过数学计算特定模式出现的概率来做出回应，这一事实表明很难将它们视为有生命的。

sentences.chinese: 然而，就我们对它们的反应而言，重要的不是它们是否有感知力，而是它们是否看起来有感知力。

sentences.chinese: 大语言模型是由真实的人类互动构成的。

sentences.english: While their tendency to hallucinate means that chatbots are not able to provide reliable factual information, they are able to effectively replicate the language used in human communication.
sentences.chinese: 虽然它们有时会出现幻觉，意味着聊天机器人无法提供可靠的事实信息，但它们能够有效地复制人类交流中使用的语言。

sentences.english: Psychologists report that people tend to have a cognitive bias towards forming attachment and trust.
sentences.chinese: 心理学家报告说，人们往往有一种认知偏差，倾向于形成依恋和信任。

sentences.english: Even sceptical technology writers report feeling some emotion towards AI chatbots.
sentences.chinese: 即使是持怀疑态度的科技作家也表示对人工智能聊天机器人产生了一些情感。

sentences.english: Some users have even reported grief when one model has been replaced by a newer one.
sentences.chinese: 一些用户甚至报告说，当一个模型被更新的模型取代时，他们感到悲伤。

sentences.english: This combination of believable human language together with the inability to reliably assess facts can be dangerous.
sentences.chinese: 这种真实可信的人类语言与无法可靠地评估事实的结合可能是危险的。

sentences.chinese: 已有报道称，聊天机器人鼓励人们做危险或非法的事情。

sentences.english: The chatbots were able to use language to encourage and persuade, but not identify or evaluate risks.
sentences.chinese: 聊天机器人能够使用语言来鼓励和说服，但无法识别或评估风险。

sentences.english: Trust becomes dangerous when it is not accompanied by reason.
sentences.chinese: 当信任没有理性相伴时，它就变得危险。

sentences.chinese: 此外，如果人们与人工智能建立关系，那么他们可能会花更少的时间和精力去培养真正的人际关系。
